DrillReport.title: Evaluation Report
DrillReport.result-in-progress: The simulation drill is in progress. At this stage, the accuracy of the drill analysis is low, and it is not recommended to use this report.
DrillReport.result-timeout: Your drill has ended. Unfortunately, you did not achieve the set goals within the allotted time.
DrillReport.result-complete: Congratulations! You have successfully completed this stage of the simulation drill and achieved the set goals.
DrillReport.result-over-target: Congratulations! You have successfully completed this stage of the simulation drill and exceeded the set goals.
DrillReport.result-general-vh: You have demonstrated exceptional leadership skills and successfully built a high-performance team.
DrillReport.result-general-h: You have demonstrated good leadership skills and built a high-performance team.
DrillReport.result-general-l: You attempted leadership behaviors but did not exhibit ideal leadership skills, resulting in an average high-performance team.
DrillReport.result-general-vl: You did not demonstrate the necessary leadership skills in the simulation and failed to build a high-performance team.
DrillReport.result-efficiency-vh: You have effectively harnessed the capabilities of your team members,
DrillReport.result-efficiency-h: You have well harnessed the capabilities of your team members,
DrillReport.result-efficiency-l: You should work on improving the capabilities of your team members,
DrillReport.result-efficiency-vl: You have not effectively improved the capabilities of your team members,
DrillReport.result-adaptable-vh: and you have a strong ability to adapt and lead the team in different situations.
DrillReport.result-adaptable-h: and you have the ability to adapt and lead the team in different situations.
DrillReport.result-adaptable-l: and you should adapt to leading the team in different situations.
DrillReport.result-adaptable-vl: and you must learn to adapt to leading the team in different situations.
DrillReport.result-revenue-explain: This set of data shows the comparison between your simulation drill and the actual achieved goals at the end. The total sales amount (RMB) is the sum of the completed order amounts.
DrillReport.result-team-explain: This set of data shows the comparison of your team's performance values, skill values, and status values at the beginning and end of the drill.
DrillReport.competency-radar-title: 5-Dimension Evaluation of Building a High-Performance Team
